author: parlay-locks
slate_notes: Thursday slate: TNF WAS @ NYG (8:15 ET, NYG -2.5), 4 NBA games, 11 NHL games. College sports excluded: PrizePicks bars college Player Picks in Indiana. Lines are sportsbook consensus proxies; PrizePicks/Underdog lines weren't publicly findable this morning, so confirm the app line matches before using a leg. Avoided Wizards players (2nd night of back-to-back, rest risk). Pick'em break-even: about 57.7% per leg for a 2-pick power play, ~54-55% for 5-6 pick flex.

legs.reasoning: Nabers is the Giants' clear first read (29.6% target share last week, 35 targets over last 4). Before last week's 5-43 dud in a 27-attempt grinder he had four straight 111+ yard games, including 11-121-1 on 20 targets vs Washington in Week 5. Kalshi prices 60+ yards at 58%; SportsLine projects 75.6. Sportsbook line 66.5 at -114 over. Fully practiced all week. Weather (wet) and a low-volume script are the main risks.
legs.injury_notes: Full practice all week (knee), no designation.

legs.reasoning: Likely averages 56.0 yds and 8.6 targets/game (~26% share), cleared 50 in 5 of 8, and torched Washington for 11-94-2 in Week 5. Washington allows 68.75 yds/game to tight ends (4th most). Line 46.5 at -114 over.

Ekeler has not had more than 8 carries in any game this season (3 vs NYG in Week 5) and splits with Rachaad White plus Daniels' scrambles. Books hang U9 at -130. Risk: White injury mid-game or a positive script; his snap share rose to 45% last week. Check that the fantasy line is 8.5 or lower; skip if posted at 6.5.
key_stats: Max 8 carries in any game this season

legs.reasoning: White is at 32.6 yds/game on 4.2 YPC and had 7-28 last week while Ekeler ate a season-high 45% of snaps. Washington is a short road dog with a backup center (Allegretti for Patrick) against the 3rd-highest blitz rate. Counterpoint: NYG allows 123.6 rush yds/g (21st) and one public model projects 47. Lower-confidence leg.
legs.injury_notes: C Lucas Patrick out (concussion); TE Yankoff out.

legs.reasoning: Market is strongly to the under: best over +134 (FanDuel) vs under -176, about 60% under after removing vig. Connor's L10 average is 4.0 SOG, so this leans on the market over recent form; Dallas is the 62% favorite (AccuScore) and limits volume at home. Only keep if the pick'em line is 3.5 (not 2.5).

Line is high at 4.5 with the best over at only +114 (FanDuel), implying the under is favored. Hughes' L10 average is 4.1 SOG, so he needs 5+ to beat us. Game total 6.5, Devils -148. Pick'em platforms often post 3.5 instead; if so, cut this leg.
legs.injury_notes: NJ: Mantha IR, Casey IR; Hughes healthy.
